note: New authored maintenance skill. Reviewed tw93/mole (GPL-3.0) behaviourally for dry-run, path validation, whitelist, process guards, operation logging, project artifact purge and installer cleanup. No Mole code, scripts, templates or assets were copied; the skill is an independent MIT implementation. Rejected Mole's uninstall, slim, automatic DNS/Spotlight/periodic optimization, system cache cleaning, and permanent-deletion defaults.
near_duplicates_merged: The user's pasted maintenance checklist was triaged rather than adopted wholesale: safe items (cache pruning, logs, Downloads triage, developer caches, startup audit) are implemented; destructive or low-value items (sudo purge, killall mDNSResponder, docker prune -a --volumes, /var/log deletion, force-empty Trash by default, blind zombie killing) are documented as rejected.
The audit, plan, apply, power and schedule scripts share one safety contract: read-only default, one category per apply, whitelist, quarantine, operation log, second-audit verification.
